evals.prompt:
Generate a Persian technical report titled 'مستند فنی سیستم' with the following sections:

1. An introduction paragraph mentioning: 'نسخه 16.0.7 منتشر شد. این نسخه شامل Next.js و React Query است.'
2. A table with columns: فیچر | نسخه | وضعیت | توضیحات containing mixed Persian/English content like 'React Query | v5.60.0 | فعال | مدیریت state'
3. An ordered list of installation steps with commands like 'npm install @tanstack/react-query'
4. A code block with JavaScript code
5. A URL: https://api.example.com/v1/users
6. An email: hello@example.com

The document must be generated as a Word document with correct RTL layout, proper mixed-direction text handling, and professional typography.
evals.expected_output:
A .docx file with:
- RTL paragraph direction throughout
- Table with correct RTL column order
- Mixed Persian/English text rendering naturally (English not reversed)
- Version numbers intact (16.0.7, 5.60.0)
- URLs and emails readable and unbroken
- Code blocks in LTR direction
- Professional Persian typography
- Correct ZWNJ usage

evals.prompt:
Generate a formal Persian business letter (نامه رسمی) with the following structure:

- Sender: شرکت فناوری نوین، تهران
- Date: ۱۴۰۵/۰۷/۱۴
- Recipient: مدیرعامل شرکت
- Subject: درخواست همکاری فنی
- Body: 3-4 paragraphs discussing a technical partnership, mentioning API endpoints like https://api.partner.com/v2/connect and version numbers like v3.2.1
- Closing: با احترام
- Signature: تیم فنی

The letter must have correct RTL layout, proper formal Persian tone, and mixed technical content (URLs, version numbers) rendered correctly.
evals.expected_output:
A .docx file with:
- Formal Persian letter structure
- RTL direction throughout
- Persian date format (۱۴۰۵/۰۷/۱۴)
- URLs intact and readable
- Version numbers correct (v3.2.1)
- Professional typography
- Correct signature block alignment

evals.prompt:
Generate Persian technical documentation for a web application with the following sections:

1. Title: 'راهنمای نصب و پیکربندی'
2. Prerequisites: Node.js 20.11.0+, npm 10.x
3. Installation steps (ordered list):
   - مرحله ۱: کلون کردن ریپازیتوری
   - مرحله ۲: نصب وابستگی‌ها با npm install
   - مرحله ۳: تنظیم فایل .env
4. Configuration table with columns: پارامتر | مقدار | توضیح containing rows like:
   - API_URL | https://api.example.com | آدرس سرور
   - VERSION | 2.4.10 | نسخه سیستم
5. A code block showing a JavaScript configuration file
6. A block quote with a technical note
7. FAQ section with 2-3 questions in Persian and technical answers

The documentation must have correct RTL layout, proper code blocks, and all technical content (URLs, versions, commands) preserved correctly.
evals.expected_output:
A .docx file with:
- Technical documentation structure
- RTL layout with proper headings
- Ordered and unordered lists
- Table with mixed Persian/English content
- Code blocks in LTR direction
- Block quote
- All technical values intact (URLs, versions, commands)
- Professional typography

evals.prompt:
Generate a Persian resume (رزومه) with the following sections:

1. Name: علی احمدی
2. Contact: ایمیل: ali@example.com | تلفن: 09121234567 | وبسایت: https://aliahmadi.com
3. Summary paragraph in Persian mentioning experience with Next.js 14, React 18, and TypeScript 5.4
4. Experience section with 2 jobs, each including:
   - Company name (English)
   - Role (Persian)
   - Dates (Persian numerals: ۱۴۰۲/۰۱/۰۱ تا ۱۴۰۴/۰۶/۳۰)
   - Description with mixed Persian/English
5. Skills section with a table: مهارت | سطح | سال تجربه
6. Education section

The resume must have correct RTL layout, proper mixed-direction content (English company names, Persian descriptions), and professional formatting.
evals.expected_output:
A .docx file with:
- RTL resume structure
- Mixed Persian/English content (company names in English, descriptions in Persian)
- Dates in Persian numerals
- Table with correct RTL direction
- Contact info with URLs and emails intact
- Professional typography

evals.prompt:
Generate a Persian quarterly report (گزارش فصلی) with the following structure:

1. Title: 'گزارش فصلی سوم' with date ۱۴۰۵/۰۶/۰۱
2. Executive summary paragraph
3. Key metrics table with columns: شاخص | مقدار | واحد | تغییرات containing:
   - کاربران فعال | ۱۲,۴۵۰ | نفر | +۱۵٪
   - درآمد | ۲,۴۵۰,۰۰۰,۰۰۰ | تومان | +۲۳٪
   - نسخه نرم‌افزار | 3.2.1 | - | - (technical version)
4. Detailed sections with:
   - Unordered list of achievements
   - Ordered list of action items
   - Nested lists for sub-items
5. A technical section with code snippets and CLI commands
6. Conclusion paragraph

The report must have correct RTL layout, proper table direction, correct Persian/Arabic numeral usage, and professional document structure.
evals.expected_output:
A .docx file with:
- RTL report structure
- Table with correct column order and alignment
- Mixed numerals (Persian for counts, Latin for versions)
- Ordered and unordered lists with correct direction
- Nested lists
- Code blocks and CLI commands in LTR
- Professional Persian typography
- Page layout with headers/footers
